hostProvides: optional isolated agent or worker contexts
conquistadorOwns: approval boundary for send, publish, spend, and external writes
missingCapabilities: uniform specialist isolation and concurrency across hosts

lifecycle.setup: Install the skills/ tree as the complete plugin (Claude /plugin, Codex overlay, or pinned skills CLI).
lifecycle.upgrade: Replace the owned plugin tree with a newer skills/ copy. Hosts do not fetch at runtime.
lifecycle.remove: Delete the owned plugin or skill directories recorded by the host. Leave user artifacts.
